title: Mar bar Chiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 45b, Ameimar reports Rav Nachman: “There are three tubes.” Mar bar Chiya teaches the reverse version. From this, Yuchasin deduces that he lived in Ameimar’s time.
He is also mentioned in Bava Batra 165b, saying, “This is what they sent him from there,” addressed to Rabbi Yirmeyah.

notes.text: The three kanim in Chullin 45b are anatomical tubes, leading toward the heart, lung and liver. The chronological conclusion belongs to Yuchasin.
